create_IndexedMatMul_module: create an IndexedMatMul module with num_linear weight matrices for grouped GEMM operations
run_FastIndexedMatMulFunction_forward: run the forward pass of FastIndexedMatMulFunction to compute Y[b,s,:] = X[b,s,:] @ W[indices[s]]
run_FastIndexedMatMulFunction_backward: run the backward pass of FastIndexedMatMulFunction to compute gradients for X and W tensors
test_IndexedMatMul_gradients: test the IndexedMatMul module gradient correctness by comparing against a reference einsum implementation
reset_IndexedMatMul_parameters: reset the IndexedMatMul weight parameters using truncated normal initialization with std based on in_features
